documents.subject: Invoice AP-00995 review
documents.body:

documents.subject: AP-00995 internal review
documents.body: Casey Team05: I am reviewing AP-00995 for Atlas Services 035. The invoice is posted, and the recorded amount is $1,702.10. The purchase order is PO-00995, with the same recorded amount. The service receipt is RC-AP-00995 and shows an accepted amount of $1,702.10. I do not see evidence here of payment or additional approval. Please flag any missing explanation or documentation before the record is treated as complete.

documents.subject: Follow-up actions for AP-00995
documents.body: Follow-up for the 2026-05-31 review: Casey Team05 should confirm whether the available invoice, purchase-order, and service-receipt records are sufficient for reconciliation. Atlas Services 035 may be contacted through ap35@supplier.example if clarification is required. The review should preserve the identifiers AP-00995, VEN-035, PO-00995, and RC-AP-00995.
